whiteboard.title: Whiteboard
whiteboard.description: Solve by hand or with the keyboard: strokes, shapes, text and formulas.
whiteboard.instructions: The board displays what you type in the math notepad (top-left). Move lines with the mouse or the arrow keys, and navigate the view with Ctrl+wheel, space+drag or the zoom buttons.

notepad.title: Math typing
notepad.hint: Type one step per line and press Enter: it renders instantly and lands on the board, top-left. ↑/↓ to move, click to edit, Ctrl+Backspace to delete.
notepad.empty: No lines yet. Type your first step below.

whiteboard.exportFallback: PNG export failed; the SVG was downloaded instead.
whiteboard.selectedHint: Selected: move it with the arrows, delete it with Del or duplicate it with Ctrl+D.

about.title: About
about.intro: Mathestudiatics is a personal, bilingual, open-source platform to study math from any device.

content.title: Content and anonymity
content.body: Study material is rewritten in our own words and without identifying data: no personal names, institutions or original material are published.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: No accounts, no tracking, no servers: study data stays on your device.
